notes.note: Checked against this change: a turn on a Session whose launch was replaced re-checks the replaced state under the turn-start lock and is refused with session_configuration_replaced when a park it queued behind failed, so it never runs in the old engine; an error status ends the binding only for an adapter declaring refusesTurnsAfterFailure, so other engines in error restart in place. agent-configuration.md states the rule; this page's claims about this source do not describe those paths and remain accurate.
